stem:
Ritu observes an Amoeba under a microscope. It is a single cell. She also sketches a neem seedling made of many cells.

Which statement about living organisms is correct?

options.text: A unicellular organism like Amoeba is not made of cells.
All living organisms are made of cells, whether they have one cell or many cells.
Every cell can survive independently as a complete organism.
Every microscopic organism consists of exactly one cell.

teacher.key_rationale: All living organisms are made of cells: one cell can be a whole organism, or many cells can build one. Unicellular organisms are still cellular; not every cell from a multicellular body is a complete organism; microscopic size does not fix the cell count at one.
